final: WITH joined AS (SELECT c.country AS country FROM races r JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId), ccount AS (SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM joined GROUP BY country), total AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS tot FROM ccount), ratio AS (SELECT cc.country, cc.cnt, cc.cnt * 1.0 / t.tot AS r FROM ccount cc CROSS JOIN total t), avgc AS (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avgcnt FROM ratio), kept AS (SELECT rt.cnt, rt.r, a.avgcnt FROM ratio rt CROSS JOIN avgc a WHERE rt.cnt > a.avgcnt) SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_kept_count, AVG(r) AS avg_kept_ratio, AVG(cnt - avgcnt) AS avg_kept_count_minus_avg FROM kept
